before: A font pick over East Asian text wrote the picked family to w:eastAsia, also for a Latin font.
after: A font pick writes w:eastAsia only when the picked family is an East Asian font, through the same w:rFonts merge.
reason: The write keeps the existing slot-wise w:rFonts merge operation, and released participants read w:eastAsia with the same meaning. Background font loading changes only local measurement.
